title: Where the SONOFF Matter code is
description: SONOFF prints the Matter QR code in the product's quick guide and shows the numeric setup code in the eWeLink app under Device Settings, where Enable Pairing Mode also makes a QR code or a code to copy.
lede: SONOFF answers the lost sticker question in one line: find the QR code in the quick guide, or the numeric code in the eWeLink app.

rows.text: SONOFF: find the QR code in the product quick guide, or use the numeric setup code in the app under Device Settings.
Device Settings, Enable Pairing Mode generates a QR code or a code to copy. The M5 Matter enters pairing mode when its button is held 5 to 10 seconds until the LED blinks rapidly.
SONOFF does not state the exact printed spot per product. Check the device body and the quick guide.
